verses.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.

verses.text: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.

segments.text: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.

verses.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

segments.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

verses.text: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

segments.text: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.text: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.

segments.text: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.

verses.text: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.

segments.text: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.

verses.text: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.

segments.text: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.

verses.text: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?

segments.text: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?

verses.text: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.

verses.text: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.

segments.text: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.

verses.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
